text: Hello and welcome to our live coverage of the Premier League fixture between Aston Villa and Sheffield United at Villa Park.
Villa host Sheffield United in a game where they will be hoping to continue their sensational run of form at home.
The Midlands club have won each of their last 15 Premier League home games, which is the longest run in their league history.
Unai Emery’s side have also had plenty of joy against today’s opponents and are unbeaten in their last 14 home league games against the newly-promoted outfit (W8 D6).
A win would see Villa climb to the top of the Premier League table, even if temporarily, with Liverpool and Arsenal set to face each other this weekend.
Sheffield United head to Villa Park in search of their first victory away from home in the Premier League this season.
The Blades have endured a difficult start to life back in England’s top flight, and have won just once in their last six matches (D1 L4).

Chris Wilder was recently appointed as manager and the Yorkshire side will be desperate to see the experienced boss turn things around, and a victory away to Emery’s men could see them climb off the bottom of the table and into 18th.
Emery has made four changes from Villa’s victory over Brentford last time out.
In defence, Digne and Lenglet come into the side, with Diego Carlos and Pau Torres dropping out.
Boubacar Kamara also misses out due to suspension, while Moreno drops to the bench, with Luiz and Bailey earning a place in the starting XI.
Meanwhile, Wilder has made five alterations from the Blades’ 2-0 defeat away to Chelsea in the Premier League.
Anel Ahmedhodzic has failed to make the matchday squad after starting in their last fixture.
Robinson comes in to replace him at the back.
On the left-hand side of defence, Larouci is named in the XI with Lowe dropping to the bench.
Elsewhere, Hamer, McBurnie, and McAtee all among the substitutes, with Baldock, Norwood, and Slimane coming in.
The players are making their way out onto the pitch ahead of kick-off.
Archer gets the game under way for Sheffield United at Villa Park!
Diaby produces a neat turn just outside the penalty area, and Trusty brings him down.
The referee awards a free-kick, and it's a matter of inches outside of the box.
Luiz and Digne are standing over it and the former lays it off for the latter, but his whipped shot goes high and wide and out for a goal-kick.
A wasted opportunity there.
McGinn receives a pass in the middle of the pitch and wastes no time trying to find Watkins in behind the defensive line.
The Scottish midfielder slightly overhits it and Foderingham rushes off his line to collect.
It's unlikely to be the only time the Villa striker looks to make that run, using his pace to his benefit.
A switched ball finds Bailey and he looks to take on Trusty.
The Jamaican winger cuts in on his left and drives into the box, before spotting Diaby on the overlap.
He takes a touch and sends a low cross into the penalty area, but the assistant referee has his flag up for offside and Wilder's men have a free-kick.
Villa work the ball well on the left and Ramsey finds the run of Digne who drives into the penalty area.
He clips it towards the back post and Watkins falls to the ground after colliding with Souza.
The Villa supporters want a penalty, and VAR is now checking it!
After a short delay, the referee has waved play on and there will be no penalty.
Instead, the Villans have a corner.
It's delivered into the box and once again, a Villa player goes to the ground.
This time it's Konsa at the back post, and VAR is checking for yet another potential penalty! However, the officials have decided it won't be a penalty this time either.
Villa have dominated the early proceedings, attempting 102 passes to Sheffield United's 19.
The Villans have had 84.1 per cent of the possession with two shots and might consider themselves slightly unfortunate not to have had a penalty.
Wilder's side appear happy to sit back and try and absorb the pressure.
Chance! Villa look to break down the right-hand side with Bailey, who spots the run of Diaby inside the box, laying the ball into his path.
The French international shoots immediately, looking to catch Foderingham out, but the Sheffield United goalkeeper makes a smart stop to deny him.
Wilder's side allowed Bailey far too much room to create on the right.
This time Villa look to attack down the left as Digne and Watkins link up well, but the latter loses possession and the Blades are able to clear.
Emery's side have predominantly looked to get at their opponents on the right-hand side with Bailey and Cash, while Diaby has also drifted wide to create an overload.
Bailey receives out wide and Cash bursts down the right-hand side on the overlap.
The Villa right-back is found and looks to deliver into the box, but it's deflected behind for a corner.
McGinn is there to take and sends a deep cross towards the back post.
Konsa comes flying out of nowhere, but he can't guide his header on target and it flies behind.
Brooks dispossesses Cash deep inside the Aston Villa half and the hosts are in trouble.
The Sheffield United attacker tries to find a team-mate in the box, but his cross is poor and Villa regain possession.
The Blades will need to make the most of these little opportunities if they want to get something out of this game.
Norwood makes a heavy, unnecessary challenge on Luiz in the middle of the pitch and the referee awards a free-kick.
He'll certainly consider himself fortunate not to have had his name taken for a booking.
The Brazilian midfielder looks in a bit of discomfort, but shortly after, he's back on his feet.
The Blades have managed to complete just 50 per cent of their passes in the first half so far.
Wilder will need to get his side to look after the ball better, with Sheffield United surrendering possession regularly, giving Villa plenty of chances to attack.
Villa have a corner after some good work by McGinn, who is standing over it ready to deliver.
He whips it towards the back post and Lenglet is there to nod it down into the path of Watkins.
The English striker takes a wild swing at it in and around the penalty spot, but he sends his strike flying over the bar.
He was slightly off balance, so it wasn't a simple chance.
Ramsey finds Watkins who slows the play down and waits for his team-mates.
He lays it into the path of Luiz who strikes it and it deflects out wide to McGinn.
The Villa midfielder tries to deliver into the box, but it cannons off a defender and out for a corner.
McGinn will take...
but it comes to nothing.
Diaby has drifted out wide and looks to get one-on-one with Trusty on the right-hand side.
He dances past his marker and makes his way into the penalty area, before cutting back onto his left and clipping a cross towards the back post, but the Blades are able to head it away from danger.
Emery's men are appealing for a penalty once again! McGinn receives the ball in midfield and fires a pass into the path of Watkins inside the penalty area.
The Villa striker takes a touch and falls to the ground, with Baldock challenging behind him.
However, the referee waves play on.
The Villa Park faithful aren't happy!
Villa have managed to touch the ball inside their opponent's box 18 times since the game got underway.
However, Emery's side have tested Foderingham between the sticks just once, so the Villans need to show a little more creativity in the final third if they want to open the scoring.
Once again, Villa try and create an overload on the right-hand side, with Diaby hugging the touchline before finding the overlapping run of Cash.
The Polish right-back carries the ball into the box and looks to cut it back for a team-mate, but Sheffield United are able to clear the danger.
Emery's side are lacking that cutting edge at the moment.
McGinn tries to find the run of Watkins in behind the Blades' defence, but Robinson is there to snuff out the danger.
Wilder's side now look to break, but Cash makes a foul and United now have a chance to throw some bodies forward from a free-kick.
Foderingham goes long, but nothing comes of it and Villa regain possession.
The fourth official has indicated that there will be a minimum of two minutes of added time at the end of the first half.
HALF-TIME: ASTON VILLA 0-0 SHEFFIELD UNITED
Aston Villa and Sheffield United go into the break at 0-0.
It's been a game with very few talking points so far as Emery's side have grown increasingly frustrated as the game has gone on.
The Blades are sitting deep and absorbing the pressure, looking to hit Villa on the break.
The hosts might feel they should have had a penalty in the opening 45 minutes, with VAR called into action on multiple occasions, but the referee is yet to point to the spot.
The Midlands outfit will need to show a little more creativity in the second half if they want to break the deadlock.
Villa have enjoyed plenty of the ball so far, managing to have 78.2 per cent of the possession.
However, they have been unable to turn their dominance into creating any clear-cut chances, producing just 0.44 expected goals (xG) since the game got under way.
Wilder's side are yet to attempt a shot on goal, so they will have to show a little more attacking intent if they want to snatch a winner in the second half.
Emery might be considering switching things up in the final third shortly after the break - could Zaniolo be the man to help them open the scoring?
Diaby gets the second half under way for Aston Villa at Villa Park!
Villa have a throw-in deep inside the opposition half, which is worked into the middle to McGinn.
He shifts it to his right to Cash who finds Diaby, and Emery's side remain patient keeping possession.
It eventually comes to Lenglet who clips the ball over the top after spotting the run of Digne, but his cross deflects behind for a corner.
The Blades look to counter with Larouci, but Bailey brings him down inside the Villa half.
The referee awards him the first booking of the game.
Larouci now goes into the book for a foul on Bailey, with Villa having a chance from a free-kick inside the United half.
Luiz carries the ball through midfield and feeds it out wide to Cash on the right-hand side.
The Villa right-back tries to find the run of Bailey who has burst beyond the opposition defence, but it dribbles straight into the arms of Foderingham and United are able to clear the danger.
Emery's side are lacking ideas at the moment.
Villa are enjoying plenty of possession in the second half but are finding it incredibly difficult to break the Blades down.
Emery's side need to show a little more creativity in the final third, and they're growing increasingly frustrated with their lack of chances since the break.
Wilder opts to take off Larouci after his earlier yellow, with Lowe coming on in his place.
It's an alteration in attack from Wilder, with Hamer entering the fray with Brooks making his way to the bench.
GOOOOOAAAALLL!! 1-0 ASTON VILLA!! The Midlands outfit finally making their dominance pay! Baldock fails to clear from a corner and Watkins pounces, playing a one-two with Ramsey.
Watkins then fires a cross towards the back post where Bailey is waiting, and he slams the ball into the back of the net! But wait...
VAR is checking it!
NO GOAL! Bailey's finish has been disallowed.
Ramsey was adjudged to have held onto the arm of Foderingham in the build-up to the goal.
After a short delay, the referee headed to his monitor after guidance from VAR, and it won't count! Still 0-0.
Bailey finds the run of Watkins who cuts inside and waits for a team-mate.
He plays the ball into the path of Diaby who looks to dance through the opposition defenders, but it deflects behind for a corner.
McGinn is there to take and he delivers towards the back post, but Konsa can't quite get there.
Bogle goes into the book for a strong challenge on Ramsey near the halfway line.
Villa have an opportunity from a free-kick as Luiz sends a cross into the box.
It's headed away and the Blades clear the danger.
Emery's side are trying everything to find a goal in the second half, but Wilder's men are defending superbly and frustrating the Midlands outfit.
Villa are now appealing for a penalty once again.
The ball bounces in the box and Baldock swings his arm towards it.
VAR is now checking whether a penalty should be awarded! Check complete...
NOT GIVEN! The referee waves play on.
It appeared to come off his shoulder.
Emery makes a change in attack, with Diaby coming off, to be replaced by Colombian striker Duran.
Villa make an alteration at left-back.
Moreno comes on in a straight swap for Digne.
Wilder looks to mix things up in attack, with McAtee coming off the bench.
Slimane is the player to make way.
Duran gives the ball away and Lowe carries it into the Villa half.
It's switched out wide to Hamer who stays patient, waiting for his team-mates to arrive.
He lays it into the path of Norwood on the edge of the box and he strikes it first time towards the top corner, but Martinez dives across his goal and holds.
That was Sheffield United's first shot of the game.
So close! The ball comes to Lowe on the left-hand side after some good work from McAtee.
He fires a delivery low and hard into the penalty area, and Konsa swings a leg at it.
It looks as though it's flying towards the top corner, but it whistles past the post and out for a corner.
The Villa fans breathe a sigh of relief!
Emery makes another change in attack.
Zaniolo enters the fray, with Bailey taking his place on the bench.
Sheffield United have started to grow into the game in the second half and are beginning to show a little more attacking intent, causing Villa some problems.
Emery will be incredibly disappointed with the lack of chances his team have created.
The Villans have managed just two shots since the break.
VAR is now called into action once again.
The are checking whether Duran should be sent off after an altercation with Robinson.
After a short delay, the referee waves play on.
GOOOOOAAAAALLLL!! 1-0 SHEFFIELD UNITED!! A clever pass finds Hamer who has burst forward from midfield into the box.
He turns inside the penalty area, sending McGinn to the ground, before firing a cross into the danger zone.
It falls to Archer, who takes aim and smashes it home! He's scored against his former club! Wilder's side have a shock lead!
Hamer came off the bench to produce a superb assist.
After an excellent turn into the penalty area, his delivery to Archer's feet was inch-perfect.
Villa are heavily pushing for an equaliser after the goal from United has sparked them into life.
A delivery is deep towards the back post from Zaniolo and Moreno finds himself unmarked before powering a header towards goal, but Foderingham makes a superb stop to deny him.
Wilder brings on some fresh legs in attack, with the goalscorer Archer replaced by McBurnie.
The fourth official indicated just a few moments ago that there would be a minimum of nine minutes of added time at the end of the game.
There has been a host of VAR checks, so it's certainly not surprising.
Villa are struggling to find a breakthrough in the final few minutes of the game.
Emery's side are passing it back and forth inside the Sheffield United half, but the lack of creativity will be a major concern for the Midlands outfit.
To their credit, Wilder's men have defended superbly.
Zaniolo goes into the book for dissent after the referee opted against awarding him a free-kick.
GOOOAAAALLLL!! 1-1 ASTON VILLA EQUALISE LATE ON! Ramsey carries the ball through the middle and shifts it out wide to Luiz.

The Brazilian gets it out of his feet and delivers into the penalty area, and Zaniolo rises above Foderingham who has come off his line, powering a header into the back of the net! Emery’s side finally turn their dominance into a goal!
Luiz's delivery tempted Foderingham to come off his line while also landing perfectly on the head of Zaniolo.
Trusty receives a yellow for an altercation in the back of the net after the goal was scored.
The Blades look to counter-attack, and Cash makes a tactical foul to prevent them going through on goal.
FULL-TIME: ASTON VILLA 1-1 SHEFFIELD UNITED
Aston Villa and Sheffield United share the spoils with the game ending 1-1.
The first half produced little action with the Midlands outfit dominating the possession but struggling to break the away team down.
There were minimal talking points in the opening 45 minutes, but the game sparked into life after the break.
Emery thought his side had opened the scoring after Bailey fired in Watkins' cross, but the goal was disallowed after a VAR check.
The Villans kept pushing, but it was the Blades who broke the deadlock, with Archer pouncing in the box to score against his former club.
It looked as though Wilder's men had won it late on, but a Zaniolo header deep into stoppage time levelled the scoring.
Villa will travel to Manchester United on Boxing Day as they look to go top of the Premier League table.
Up next for Sheffield United, they will host fellow strugglers Luton Town at Bramall Lane.
That's all for today, goodbye!
